Name: Farmer 2.0 ESWF
Author: saltyDG
Description:
[size=3]Please note I am no longer working in this mod and if anyone wants to take over, they are more than welcome! Sorry my mental health has unfortunately gotten the better of me and as of right now I am unable to work anymore on this project. The mod as of 11/28/25 still works with a couple of hiccups but will no longer be updated in the foreseeable future. 

As of right now 256 resolution is incompatible due to HD portraits updating to 1.6
Please read articles and changelog to see what's been added!
If you have any issues with the new update please comment or message and include your smapi log if possible!!
[/size][center]
[size=3]Only works with custom portraits[/size]

[color=#ff7700][size=4]!!! When updating, first make sure to back up your portraits into another folder,
as on update you should always delete the old version and your mod
manager will (ask you to) delete the previous files !!![/size][/color][/center][center][size=3]
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19503], [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18384]Fashion Sense Outfits[/url] to apply different portraits and
outfits during every season and different weather automatically. 

I highly recommend [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]jazzybee[/url] and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113] poltergeister[/url] portrait creator, it is the one I use and the one you see in the mod images and files!

If you are new please see and read the articles!
They have how to do everything in there and breaks it down so it is less overwhelming <3[/size][/center][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]There are currently 2 different options for this mod; please read the file descriptions to see what would be best for you![/size]
[size=4]Only download ONE Main File option!![/size][/center]

[size=4]Adds[/size]
[size=3]- different portraits for NPC emotion reactions, aka when an NPC is sad you can "react" to that[/size]
[size=3]- portraits and outfits for the different seasons, weather, and indoor options[/size]
[size=3]- plus, different outfits and portraits when [/size]
[size=3] ﻿- mining, including seasonal mining,[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- going to bed, [/size]
[size=3] ﻿- gardening (being in the greenhouse), [/size]
[size=3] ﻿- visiting the desert, and [/size]
[size=3] ﻿- island, including one for weather changes[/size]
[size=3]- different portraits and outfits for all of the festivals including some modded festivals  [/size]
[size=3]- ps. community day should be turned off until you have unlocked that event (i am unable to make it unlock after the event as of right now)[/size]
[center][size=3]﻿[/size][/center][size=5][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226?tab=articles][center]Please see articles on how to set up portraits and outfits!![/center][/url]﻿[/u][/size]
[size=4]Config - through the Generic Mod Config Menu[/size]
[size=3]- turn on portraits and outfits individually[/size]
[size=3]- turn off use background when using another mod such as [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url]
[size=3]- rename outfits[/size]
[size=3]- all of the outfits can be turned on and off you do not have to use all of the portrait and outfit options provided :)[/size]
[size=3]- ps just dont make the outfits is you dont want to use them (ex. only make "Winter" and "Winter Snow" outfits if that is all you want to use in that season) [/size]

[size=4]ReadMe [/size]
[size=3]- there is a detailed read me in the files please use this as a guide and instructions on how to add your own portraits if you do not understand the articles[/size]

[size=4]Setup[/size]
[size=3]- there is a folder within the files named setup, you should not need to go into this file for any reason other than if you are adding new emotions.[/size]
 
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[size=3]- 1.6 compatible[/size]
[size=3]- works with all fashion sense addons[/size]
[size=3]- the morning pajamas portrait and outfit will not show up when you first load into the game, or skip days (as of right now i am unable to change this)[/size]
[size=3]- there are options for the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6688]Surfing Festival[/url][size=3] and the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15277]New Years Festival[/url][size=3], as of right now they are not compatible for 1.6 but if they get updated you will be able to create outfits and portraits for them (please do not go and ask the creators for updates I am sure they are working very hard)[/size]
[size=3]- has been tested with multiplayer (not split screen) and does work but please see article on how to correctly set up farmhand portraits
- currently does not work for split screen[/size]

[size=4]Upcoming Features[/size]
[size=3]- Possible outfit for the updated [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309]Market Town[/url][size=3] mod by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104424638]d5a1lamdtd[/url]

[size=4]Extra[/size]
[size=3]- the mods that sara uses in her image are [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899]Portrait Frame Variations[/url][size=3]﻿ and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url]
[size=3]-if you have any questions or festivals that you want added please feel free to reach out[/size]
[size=3]-if there are any new emotions yall want please leave a comment![/size]
[size=3]- dont forget to turn your portraits on in the farmer portraits for 1.6 mod![/size]

[center][size=4]Acknowledgements and Credits
Huge shoutout to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/21934209]Liliet[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/130944333]MistySprings[/url], and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]Aedenthorn[/url]!! [/size]

[size=3]-  [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/21934209]Liliet for the og seasonal looks
[/url][size=3]- [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/130944333]MistySprings[/url][size=3]    for the new portrait maker and farmer emotions[/size]

[/size][center][size=3]Please see the original mod descriptions if you want to know more about them! [/size]

[/size]
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FN9eD-686YUNiXeugUyFv3WV7CTicE4mojWcKhP9EWw/edit?usp=sharing]My Stardew Mod Recommendations[/url]﻿

I am currently working on translations for the mod and right now i am just using an online translator, if you would like to help make this mod more accessible for others, please reach out to me!! I have a base folder for translation and i can walk you through when to translate!! Any help is truly appreciated <3[/center]
